Definition: Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ur = "flame"; 1) city in southern Babylonia, city of the Chaldeans, centre of moon worship, home of Abraham's father, Terah, and departure point for the Abraham's migration to Mesopotamia and Canaan
